responsibility: Defines the error and result infrastructure for MIR interpretation and const evaluation, including reported-vs-generic evaluation failures, interpreter error kinds with backtraces, macros for constructing propagation errors, and the guarded `InterpResult` wrapper that prevents accidental loss of UB-relevant failures.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the crate-root `error.rs`, which declares reusable diagnostics for `rustc_middle`, and `ty/error.rs`, which focuses on formatting type comparison failures, this file defines MIR interpreter and const-eval failure machinery: interpreter error kinds, propagation macros, and the guarded `InterpResult` used to prevent silent loss of UB-related errors.
